Karnataka Suspends IAS Officer Gyanendra Kumar Gangwar After Arrest in Recruitment Scam

The Karnataka government has suspended IAS officer Gyanendra Kumar Gangwar following his arrest in connection with an alleged corruption case involving recruitment conducted by the Karnataka Public Service Commission (KPSC). The suspension was announced after Gangwar's arrest, which is linked to irregularities in the KPSC recruitment process. The specific details of the alleged corruption and the exact nature of Gangwar's involvement are part of an ongoing investigation.
